consent.leave_at_gate: Let the guard keep this parcel if you are away. You can change your mind until the guard takes it.
consent.required_for_leave_at_gate: The household has not allowed this parcel to be left at the gate.
consent.revoke_too_late: The guard already holds this parcel, so the permission can no longer be withdrawn.
custody.courier_says_delivered: The courier says it was delivered. This is the courier's statement, not proof that the society holds the parcel.
custody.gate_entry_is_not_delivery: A rider entering the gate is not a delivery.
custody.in_society_custody: The society is holding this parcel.
custody.not_in_custody: The society does not hold this parcel.
pickup.denied.already_collected: This parcel was already collected. The attempt was recorded.
pickup.denied.delegation_required: A family member can collect only with the household's delegated authority.
pickup.denied.screenshot_not_accepted: A screenshot of an order is not accepted as proof.
pickup.denied.supervision_required: Collecting without a code needs the guard supervisor.
pickup.denied.token_expired: This code has expired. Ask the household for a new one.
pickup.token_instruction: Show this code to the guard to collect the parcel. It works once and expires in {hours} hours.
reminder.h24: A parcel for {unit} has been at the gate for 24 hours. Please collect it.
reminder.h48: A parcel for {unit} has been at the gate for 48 hours. Please collect it soon.
report.physical_over: The physical count is {n} higher than the system.
report.physical_short: The physical count is {n} lower than the system. Nothing was marked lost.
report.reconciled: The physical count matches the system ({n}).
